minimal_native_corrections.problem: typeof type query consumes union as runtime expression
minimal_native_corrections.mechanism: TypeOf calls VariableOrPropertyAccess::from_reader, which parses full Expression then try_into. For typeof FileReader.EMPTY | typeof FileReader.LOADING the union bar is consumed as runtime bitwise expression and rejected as invalid LHS.
minimal_native_corrections.proposed_fix: Use a type-query-specific native member/qualified-name parser or sufficiently tight existing member-access precedence, so the surrounding native type parser retains |/&/conditional delimiters. Keep runtime assignment parsing unchanged; reject invalid qualified names explicitly.
tests: typeof A.X | typeof A.Y produces Union of two TypeOf nodes with exact source ranges.
Malformed typeof A. fails with span.

minimal_native_corrections.problem: namespace ambient const routed as runtime initializer-required declaration
minimal_native_corrections.mechanism: Namespace body uses generic Block parser. const chooses VariableDeclaration<Expression>, which requires Assign; existing DeclareVariableDeclaration already permits optional initializer and preserves VariableKeyword::Const.
minimal_native_corrections.proposed_fix: In type_definition_module ambient context route const to existing DeclareVariableDeclaration::from_reader_sub_declare with no explicit declare prefix; preserve name/keyword/type/span. Do not manufacture initializer or broadly allow runtime const without initializer. Namespace synthesis support remains separate and must not be hidden.
tests: namespace Intl { const PluralRules: PluralRulesConstructor; } yields real ambient const node.
Ambient object-valued constructor declaration with semicolon parses.

minimal_native_corrections.problem: rest destructuring unsupported in type annotation AST and signature checker
minimal_native_corrections.mechanism: TypeAnnotationSpreadFunctionParameter.name is String and parser consumes identifier only. Ordinary rest parser already has VariableField under extras. Checker currently registers one string name and reduces rest constraint to homogeneous Array<T>; []|[TNext] becomes ERROR_TYPE. Call engine compares any number of arguments against scalar item_type without checking tuple arity.
minimal_native_corrections.proposed_fix: Preserve native VariableField in annotation-rest AST, parse it using existing pattern parser, serialize its actual pattern, register bound identifiers through real register_variable destructuring. Then validate assembled rest argument tuple against the complete native constraint (including tuple union and generic substitution), reusing native subtype infrastructure if it really preserves lengths/positions. Keep display text separate from binding identity. Never replace [value] by a synthetic label or ERROR/any and count success.
minimal_native_corrections.estimated_scope: Not a whole-AST rewrite: existing VariableField and destructuring helpers can be reused. But this crosses parser AST, native binding and call-signature/domain semantics; it is materially more than a parser fix. A bounded isolated implementation experiment is needed to see whether tuple/union subtype and arity are reusable.
